description: Costs 1 credit per page crawled — submitting the crawl itself is free. Returns a job ID immediately — poll it with domscout_get_job. Always respects robots.txt (this cannot be disabled), caps at 500 pages and depth 5, and requires an explicit HTTPS allowedOrigins list. Requires a Business plan or above.

allowedOrigins.description: Bare https origins the crawl may visit, e.g. "https://example.com". Must include the seed origin.

seedUrl.description: Where to start. Must be https.

name: domscout_crawl_site
title: Crawl a set of pages under an allowlist
